description_en: Queries the performance data of an ApsaraDB RDS instance at the storage layer by calling the DescribeRDSPerformance operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeRDSPerformance接口查询存储层RDS性能数据详情
kebab_example: aliyun drds describe-rds-performance --drds-instance-id drds000000000 --rds-instance-id rm-000000000000 --keys MySQL_MemCpuUsage --api-version 2019-01-23 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeRDSPerformance

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">Instance ID of the PolarDB-X instance.</props>

parameters.name: rds_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186705.html
parameters.help_zh:
性能监控指标，允许一次传入多个指标进行查询，多个指标参数间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
更多关于性能监控指标详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186705.html

NodeName.description_en:
The node name.

节点名称。
仅数据库存储类型为PolarDB MySQL时返回该参数，RDS MySQL不会返回该参数

Values.description_en: The details of the monitoring metrics data
